title: Thavarige Baa Thangi
desc: Aakash's parents falsely accuse Lakshmi of infidelity to secure a wealthy bride for him. However, her brother supports her.

title: Love Birds
desc: Mridula relocates to the UK to nurse her broken heart after her lover Arun dies. However, when she meets a man who looks exactly like him, she tries to find his true identity.

title: Taarak
desc: An aspiring journalist is recruited by a popular newspaper to write weekly articles aimed at inspiring college students.

title: Ee Bandhana
desc: An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.

title: Anna Bond
desc: Bond Ravi, a martial arts champion, and Meera, a documentary film-maker, fall in love with each other. However, she gets kidnapped by a drug lord, prompting Bond to spring into action.
